program.section_heading: Basic Office Software Skills Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate how to navigate a word processing software while creating a document that includes text.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate how to navigate the basics of a presentation software while creating a visual presentation.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate how to navigate the basics of a spreadsheet software while creating a basic spreadsheet assignment.

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space (OFFTB92NC, OFFTB93NC, OFFTB94NC). These match the closed-list codes OFFT B92NC, OFFT B93NC and OFFT B94NC, so none is marked as a catalog addition.
The catalog states that credits are in hours ('Credits listed are in hours (36 hours)', 'Total 36'), so measure is hours and all unit fields hold hours.
The page names the award 'Certificate of Completion' in its heading and requirements, but the 'To Achieve' paragraph says 'Certificate of Competency'. A reviewer should check which name is correct.
The block's stated total of 36 comes from the program total and the line '(36 hours)' printed under 'Complete all of the following'.
A stray '0' appears after 'Credits listed are in hours (36 hours)' and was ignored.
